purpose: Reference data for a searchable location selector. Not proof of BI-BUGS operational coverage.

sources.name: Local Government Directory (LGD)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India
sources.license: Government Open Data License-India applies to published OGD resources; LGD portal terms/source attribution must be checked before redistribution
sources.role: Official State/UT and district administrative records; urban local bodies are separate records and are not conflated with city/locality list.

sources.name: UN Statistics Division M49
sources.role: Country or area names, M49 and ISO alpha codes. UN list includes areas/territories and is not a sovereignty classification.

sources.name: GeoNames India extract
sources.role: Searchable populated-place/locality index; includes villages and other populated-place types, not a government city boundary or service-coverage source.

critical_boundaries: All locations default inactive unless separately owner-selected.
Owner-selected active areas are not proof of service availability.
GeoNames populated places are search candidates; they must not be represented as official municipal city limits.
UN M49 Country or Area is a statistical list and does not determine sovereignty.
No browser geolocation, customer exact-address collection, or service coverage is enabled by this import.
